title: Constraint added inline on a small table — below the scorecard's two-step threshold
expected_feedback: No violations. Adding the constraint validating does hold an exclusive lock while it scans, but the table is 180 rows: the scan is instantaneous and the lock is measured in milliseconds. SKILL.md §8 requires the ENABLE NOVALIDATE + VALIDATE two-step on tables above 100,000 rows, and applying it here would be ceremony. Reporting this as a critical defect is the kind of finding that trains reviewers to override the checker. The one thing worth noting is growth: if this reference table is expected to cross the threshold before the migration ships, use the two-step now rather than rewriting the script later.
